Class SortingWFS_2_0_Strategy

java.lang.Object
org.geotools.data.ows.Specification
org.geotools.data.wfs.internal.WFSStrategy
org.geotools.data.wfs.internal.AbstractWFSStrategy
org.geotools.data.wfs.internal.v2_0.StrictWFS_2_0_Strategy
org.tailormap.api.geotools.wfs.SortingWFS_2_0_Strategy
public class SortingWFS_2_0_Strategy extends org.geotools.data.wfs.internal.v2_0.StrictWFS_2_0_Strategy
StrictWFS_2_0_Strategy that sends the sort order of the query to the server, as SORTBY for GET and fes:SortBy for POST. GeoTools 35.2 leaves this out (it is commented out in StrictWFS_2_0_Strategy), so with paging each page is sorted on its own in memory, see SortingWFSClient.

SortBy.NATURAL_ORDER (no property name) is not sent: with no sort order the server uses its own (natural) order. ContentFeatureSource adds NATURAL_ORDER itself when paging without a sort order, for stable paging. SortBy.REVERSE_ORDER can't be done by a WFS and is an error.

Sorting on an attribute when the server doesn't implement sorting (no ImplementsSorting constraint) is an error. SortingWFSClient says it can sort, so GeoTools doesn't sort in memory, which is wrong with paging.

This can be removed when GeoTools sends the sort order for WFS 2.0.0 itself.
